answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The ridge multiplier is published, charged in basalt, and oasis lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3034 identities would post 4198 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
